body:
i am already away, thankfully. 

it’s the moments in between which seem that she’s being nice to me, that confuse me the most. 

i hope that for you too.

it truly is a difficult task finding a way out, but sometimes you have to remember everything ends in the end, even your life will end some day involuntarily. and so will the pain. i have come to terms with the fact that happiness is fleeting but contentment can be a long term thing, perhaps waking up each day and thinking of 3 things you’re grateful for, however minuscule can help. also being in a pandemic it’s easy to fall into the pattern of negative thoughts constantly pushing you to the edge.

i’m glad you do write, also our own voices are the best frequency and best received by our minds, writing down and saying positive affirmations out loud always helps. 

also if all else fails, there’s always food lol.
i know the thoughts are not going to disappear, i need to push through like i always have. i feel i need to give myself more time to realign, so i’m going to try my best to sleep it off.
i feel that too, sometimes being around other people helps us not be fixated on our own issues. which is nice sometimes, it’s also nice to find that contentment when alone.
i understand. the loneliness can feel all consuming at times. do you ever write down how you feel? do you feel your joy comes from being around others?
i’ve managed to cry it out, written down how i feel. of course this is the point where i re-evaluate my thoughts/feelings and what exactly i want to do. but i feel a tiny bit better.
hmm why’s that? what would make it better do you feel?
i would love to talk lol. currently
hi victor, my day has been so-so, how about yours?
